strings.name: Simon Johnson
strings.summary: Educated at Oxford, Manchester and MIT, Johnson studies institutions, financial crises and technological change and formerly served as IMF chief economist. With Acemoglu and Robinson, he examined how institutions shape prosperity, sharing the 2024 economics Nobel. His books also address banking power and the distribution of technological gains. In 2026 he was named chair of the UK's AI Economics Institute.
